title: BedWars enters beta at the Cookie Colosseum
summary: Protect your bed, spend bakery cookies and fight across a purpose-built floating arena—now in beta on Java and Bedrock.
body:
Cookie BedWars is now open in beta on Cookie Build. Join a team, defend your bakery bed, collect cookies at your base, bridge to diamond and emerald islands, and eliminate every rival team in the Cookie Colosseum.

Java players get native inventory shops and Bedrock players get native forms backed by the same prices and rules. Because this is a beta, the mode may be temporarily disabled while we fix an issue. Please do not hesitate to send us any bug you find on Discord or Twitter/X—it genuinely helps us improve the game.

Java: play.cookie-build.com
Bedrock: play.cookie-build.com, port 19132
Discord: https://discord.gg/ajmPnwh9g8
